actualVisualInspection.method: Root physically viewed both complete unmodified source PNGs and adopts the independent actual PS2 footage/canonical reference comparison.

limits: Exact source-only job approval, not GUI/installation/Git/runtime/production admission.
Original fan transformation tied to its canonical incarnation, not an official retail costume or absolute1:1 certificate.
Geometry masks measured at alpha>16; low-alpha fringes unclaimed. Manual pelvis/neutral datums are visual source measurements, not physical metre/anatomical certificates.
Original fighter, source sprite, frame clocks, phase maps, gameplay parameters and historical display height remain preserved.
Adult MGS2 Vamp only: bare male torso, suspenders, dark ponytail, knives, scars and decomposed skin. No green MGS4 sleeve or different incarnation is merged.
Two real atlas bands per direction use their measured upright witnesses. No per-pose/crouch/KO height normalization. Live preview proportions and all source units remain for real GUI review.
Knife is held/released on the independently reviewed native sources; supers remain melee blade. Utility16 is undead recovery, never firearm reload.
